newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks tumble to close lower.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks tumble to close lower.

text.p: Madrid stocks tumbled on Wednesday to close down in what dealers saw as a correction to Tuesday's historic highs and as bonds and other stock markets tumbled.
The General index slipped to close 2.75 points, 0.73 percent, down at 372.77. The Ibex-35 lost 32.89 points, 0.76 percent, to 4,295.47.
"The fall in bonds encouraged selling in afternoon trading and in the short term the market looks volatile," said a trader at ABN-AMRO.
Electricity companies, which attracted considerable attention during Tuesday's rally on reduced fears of tougher regulations in the sector, continued to be heavily traded.
Electricity company Endesa closed down 70 pesetas, 0.88 percent, at 7,880. Iberdrola ended 15 pesetas down at 1,310.
Telefonica also remained a focus for trading, ending down five pesetas at 2,490. Repsol fell 55 pesetas, 1.22 percent, to 4,455.
Traders said they would remain cautious after Wednesday's losses and did not rule out the possibility of extended stock losses if bonds continued their downward spiral.
